How to order

No account and no checkout forms. Three steps and your order is with us.

  1. Choose your pair

    Pick a shoe in the showroom, select your size, and add it to your order. Add as many pairs as you like.

  2. Send on WhatsApp

    Enter your name and city, then send. Your full order reaches us as one message.

  3. We confirm with you

    We reply on WhatsApp to confirm availability, delivery details, and payment.
